item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i dbal mo las kyi gting zlog las gdug pa drag po'i b+ho zlog
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug(phugs) gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las/ dbal mo las kyi thig le gdug pa drag po'i b+h+yoH bzlog (zlog) 'di yang*/ 'chi med yum sras gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnag pa/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi dmar (smar) byang 'di yang / dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung gis bskul ba dang*/ dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor/ sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'bring / stang chen dmu tsha'i bka' yi pho nyar mngags pa'i/ rgod rje'i rus thob u0f38drung mu thogs med rtsal lam 7mi 'gyur tshe dbang bde chen snying por 'bod pa des/ dbal gyi phur pa nag pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i mdun zhol/ dpal ldan nor bu gling ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du/ lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol nas dus dang skabs la bab par dran nas/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung brgyud pa bzhin/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o/ 'di bris gsas mkhar lha dang bla mar bshags / bstan skyong dam can sde la bzod par gsol/ dge des byad dang sbod gtong kun zhi nas/ gsang sems zab mo'i ngang la gnas gyur cig/
